frequency_question: What proportion of major contested regulatory proposals advance from initial proposal/signal to final publication within the specified timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes economically significant rules published for notice and comment that face substantial public opposition or litigation threats; excludes routine administrative fee adjustments.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named major rules; representative of highly contested high-salience administrative actions.
known_gaps: Rules abandoned prior to final publication due to administrative shifts or immediate judicial injunctions before the final rule stage.
skeleton: 6 named major contested rules across recent administrations, all of which successfully reached final publication despite intense controversy and legal challenges.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 observed major contested regulatory tracks reaching final publication within target windows.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to standard administrative procedure timelines and executive branch rulemaking velocity, which remains stable across a single presidential term.
